_doc: General brawls (src/state/brawl.ts, game/workers/brawl.ts). Clashes are only counted and brawls only started between waves; a running brawl continues if a wave starts and takes over the live-stream split screen (BRAWL badge). Two Generals 'clash' when they bump into each other (closer than clashRadiusPx); a clash counts once per contact (they must part by partRadiusPx first) and only at the pair's same spot (within spotRadiusTiles of where their tension started; a clash elsewhere restarts the gauge there). More than clashesToBrawl clashes fill the tension gauge and start a brawl outside waves. The Generals fight to the death. Each win adds absorb.attack/hp (10%) of the loser's current attack and HP, with a maximum of maxLevel wins; the dead General is replaced through the normal promotion flow. Mirror invaders keep the realm fair: while any General has a +, each wave invader may copy one upgraded General's attack and HP (chance + perLevel × its level, at most one mirror per upgraded General each wave; never bosses).
